correctness_confidence.basis: Formal verification in Lean 4 (4.35.0) with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, zero Classical.choice, and zero warnings across 18 theorems, plus an exact Python verifier with 70 passing tests over 16 canonical certificates.

novelty.basis: Novel companion verification suite and constructive Lean 4 / Python verification framework auditing OpenAI's 1/2 logarithmic exponent theorems for finite Fourier transforms.

reproducibility.basis: Complete reproducibility via deterministic Lean 4 compilation, SHA-256 manifests, explicit JSON certificates (C01-C16), and comprehensive adversarial testing.

rigor.basis: Meticulous verification of algebraic identities, finite field matrix equations, nilpotent time expansions, Hermite spectral repairs, and Bluestein chirp specializations with explicit arithmetic witnesses.

significance.basis: Provides rigorous independent machine-checked verification of complex algebraic and spectral-repair mechanisms for foundational FFT complexity bounds.

strengths: Rigorous formal verification in Lean 4 with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, and zero Classical.choice.
Extensive verification suite covering 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16) and 70 adversarial pytest checks.
Explicit worked hand-verifiable arithmetic witnesses connecting algebraic and spectral repair mechanisms.
strong_novelty_candidates: Constructive Lean 4 verification suite for finite-dimensional algebraic and spectral-repair certificates of FFT logarithmic exponents.
summary: The paper presents FFT-EXP-HALF-CERT-1.0, an independent verification suite auditing OpenAI's 1/2 logarithmic exponent preprint for finite Fourier transforms. It features 18 machine-checked theorems in Lean 4 with zero sorry/axioms and 16 canonical JSON certificates verified by an exact Python verifier.
weaknesses: Scope intentionally excludes full end-to-end formalization of Grassmannian compactness and Hoeffding tail asymptotics.
Relies on external preprint definitions for asymptotic recursion over arbitrary fields.
